references.text: Describes the Levitical cities and their surrounding pasturelands that were to be given to the Levites as an inheritance
The fundamental principle that the land belongs to the Lord and cannot be sold permanently
Previous verses addressing the Levites' right to redeem their houses in the Levitical cities
Complete description of the Levitical cities and their pasturelands as their permanent possession
Ezekiel's prophetic vision confirms that the Levites' land must not be sold or exchanged because it is holy to the Lord
The fulfillment of the command to give the Levites cities with pasturelands from the inheritance lands of the tribes
Explains why the Levites had limited land rights—the Lord himself was their inheritance
